headline: Eleven, the coffee has gone cold.
body: The window glass has warmed under the sun. A single leaf rests on the sill. Somewhere a radio plays low, then stops.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: bright, almost white at the edges

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: direct, cutting the desk in half

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: still, a dog crossing far down
